//playlists: YouTube returns no user-defined order (the channel-page arrangement lives in the separate channelSections API and only covers sections you have explicitly built), so the order is set here. Entries may be a playlist title or its id; ids survive a rename. Anything listed in `order` leads, in this order. Everything else follows, largest first, so a new playlist shows up without being configured — just not at the top.
//home: The video rows on the homepage's Watch panel, in order. `latest` is the newest uploads minus every video in the `exclude` playlists. Each entry in `playlists` is one more row, in that playlist's own order, minus its `exclude` playlists. Playlists are named by title or id, as above. A row that names no playlist, or has nothing left to show, is left out rather than failing the build.

links.//youtubeLive: Stable URL that resolves to the current live stream, or to the channel when there is none. Used as the secondary call to action while streaming, since both platforms run at once.
links.//twitchSchedule: The Twitch stream schedule as a calendar feed. The hero's Add to calendar link, and the source scripts/fetch-schedule.mjs reads into data/schedule.json.
